How joining works

Designed to require very little administrator upkeep.

  1. 1
    Create accountEmail verification through Supabase Auth.
  2. 2
    Choose a planSelect Basic or Advanced based on the profile features you want.
  3. 3
    Build your profileProvider controls public information, links, availability, specialties, and other listing details.
  4. 4
    Submit for initial reviewIdentity/credential details are checked before first publication.
  5. 5
    Maintain it yourselfUpdate availability, insurance, bio, media, and links whenever needed.
  6. 6
    Confirm periodicallyAutomatic reminders keep “last verified” dates fresh.
